He just dictated: formulae, tables, drawings explained point by point. It was the last part of his Masterwork, the part death had not let him finish. At the end of the third night the needle stopped, went back to the middle and wrote one last sentence: *"Now leave me in peace."*
Non ci chiese come stavamo. Non ci disse.short: He asked nothing: he dictated the last part of his Masterwork. Then the needle tapped: *"Now leave me in peace."*

Lo abbiamo fatto. Il Masterwork è finito.easy: We did. The Masterwork is finished, Doctor, and it was published with his name. The Telegraph is taken apart, in the attic. We have never switched it on again.
Lo abbiamo fatto. Il Masterwork è finito.short: The Masterwork was published. The Telegraph is in the attic, dismantled.

Egregio dottore, la Chiesa ha vinto, e n.easy: Dear Doctor, the Church won, and it was not a gentle victory. The bishop came to {0} in the spring of 1906 with a decree, two policemen and a list of names. Our family's name was first.
Egregio dottore, la Chiesa ha vinto, e n.short: Dear Doctor, the Church won. The bishop came in 1906 with a list of names, and ours was first.

La sede del Circolo bruciò la notte di P.easy: The Circle's building burned on the night of Pentecost. Somehow the fire crossed the road and reached the estate. The greenhouses, the cages, the laboratory and the volumes of the Journal burned. The Telegraph, as it melted, made a noise the firemen described as a cry of pain.
La sede del Circolo bruciò la notte di P.short: At Pentecost the Circle burned, and the fire reached the estate. The Telegraph melted with a wail.

Sulle ceneri il vescovo ha fatto costrui.easy: On the ashes the bishop had a chapel built for the souls in purgatory. I go there every Sunday, like everyone. The priest says its walls are the quietest in the diocese, and he is right: no one ever knocks there.
Sulle ceneri il vescovo ha fatto costrui.short: A chapel now stands on the ashes. Its walls are the quietest in the diocese.

Ma nella cripta, sotto l'altare, dove un.easy: But in the crypt, under the altar, where the laboratory used to be, the sexton has not gone down for years.

Egregio dottore, lei mi chiede chi gover.easy: Dear Doctor, you ask me who is in charge in {0}. On paper, the town council, and a mayor who is still called Bódi. In reality, since that night in 1905, every decision goes first across a little table.
Egregio dottore, lei mi chiede chi gover.short: Dear Doctor, the council governs {0}. But since 1905 every decision passes first across a little table.

La Grande Seduta finì con la nostra fami.easy: The Great Séance ended with our family leading the Circle of the Last Hour, and the Circle welcomed us like an heir it had waited for a long time. The undertaker's, the bank, the newspaper, the school: everything is ours, or belongs to someone who owes us a favour. The widows bless us. And, people say, so do the dead.
La Grande Seduta finì con la nostra fami.short: We lead the Circle, and everything is ours or owes us a favour. The widows bless us, and so do the dead.

Non creda che sia un potere comodo. Ogni.easy: Do not think it is a comfortable power. Every Thursday evening we ask advice from those who came before us, and the dead are difficult advisers: they forget nothing, forgive nothing, and have all the time in the world.
Non creda che sia un potere comodo. Ogni.short: But the dead are demanding counsellors: they forget nothing, forgive nothing, and have all the time in the world.

Le scrivo con il loro permesso. Mi hanno.easy: I am writing with their permission. They asked me to tell you that your work has been noticed, and that, whenever you want, there will be a chair for you too at our table. I advise you not to want it.
Le scrivo con il loro permesso. Mi hanno.short: They ask me to tell you there is a chair for you at our table. I advise you not to want it.

Caro dottore, la riconosco dalla calligr.easy: Dear Doctor, I recognise you by your handwriting. You, however, will not recognise mine: it is not the handwriting of the person who signs this letter. Since the night of the Great Séance, when the vial broke in the hands of {0}, this hand has written for me.
Caro dottore, la riconosco dalla calligr.short: Dear Doctor, you will not recognise my hand. Since the vial broke in the hands of {0}, this hand has written for me.

Mi presento, anche se forse ha già capit.easy: Let me introduce myself, though perhaps you have already understood: Eszter Vámos, consoler. For fifty years they called me a cheat, a witch, a prophet, a saint. They were all a little right. The secret of eternal life, Doctor, was not for sale: it was in that vial. I only had to find the right person, mad enough to let me in.
Mi presento, anche se forse ha già capit.short: I am Eszter Vámos, consoler. The secret of eternal life was in that vial: I only needed someone mad enough to let me in.

Questo corpo è più giovane del mio, e ha.easy: This body is younger than mine and has warmer hands: I use it carefully. I am writing to you because you are reading my records, and I have always liked people who read me carefully.
Questo corpo è più giovane del mio, e ha.short: This body is young, and I use it with care. I write because you read my minutes so attentively.

Ho cercato a lungo un erede vivente da i.easy: I looked for a long time for a living heir to question, as I did for the other documents in the file. I did not find one. The papers end on the night of 31 December 1905, in the middle of a record: the veil was torn, and the family voted not to cross it. Then, says the last line, "the fog came in through the windows".
Ho cercato a lungo un erede vivente da i.short: I found no living heir. The papers stop on 31 December 1905: the veil was torn, the family did not cross it, and "the fog came in through the windows".

Dal 1906 {0} non compare più sulle carte.easy: Since 1906 {0} is no longer on any map. Trains do not stop there, the telegraph does not answer, and travellers who try to get there say they walked for hours in a white fog, around a cemetery, before finding themselves back where they started.
Dal 1906 {0} non compare più sulle carte.short: Since 1906 {0} has vanished from the maps. Those who try to reach it walk for hours in the fog, around a cemetery, and end up where they began.

Mi chiederete, allora, dove ho trovato q.easy: So you will ask me where I found these crates. I ask myself too. I remember the evening train, the umbrella, the kind and very tired priest. I do not remember how I left the village.
Mi chiederete, allora, dove ho trovato q.short: Where did I find these crates? I remember the train, the umbrella, the priest. I do not remember leaving the village.

Scrivo dal mio studio di Budapest. Dalla.easy: I am writing from my study in Budapest. For three days I have seen only fog from the window. And someone, politely, is knocking.

Alla tenuta, quella notte, i colpi alle.easy: That night, at the estate, the knocking on the walls is softer than usual. Almost shy.
